integrations.intro: Haɗa dandamalin lafiya, ayyuka, da waƙa. Motsa jikin da aka shigo daga WHOOP na sirri ne da farko, sannan kai ka zaɓi abin da za a raba da koci-koci ko jerin al'umma.
integrations.noteAppleHealthNative: Karanta taku, bugun zuciya, HRV, bugun zuciya a hutu, barci, kuzarin da aka kashe, da motsa jiki daga Apple Health (haɗa da Apple Watch ɗinka) cikin bayanan ranarka.
integrations.noteAppleHealthWeb: Bayanan Apple Health (da Apple Watch) suna nan a manhajar Shape ta iOS kawai. Buɗe Shape a iPhone ɗinka don ka haɗa.
integrations.noteAppleMusic: Ba MusicKit izini ga Apple Music don amfani da ɗakin karatunka wajen jerin waƙoƙin motsa jiki. Kai kake ba da izini a nan — babu tura ka wani wuri.
integrations.noteGarmin: Ja ayyuka, bugun zuciya, da barci daga Garmin Connect zuwa bayananka. Yana buƙatar amincewar Garmin Health API a asusun mai haɓakawa.
integrations.noteInstacart: Aika jerin sayayyar da kocinka ya gina zuwa Instacart ka buɗe keken sayayya da aka riga aka cika. Yayin da ake jiran izinin Instacart, ana kwafi jerin zuwa allon liƙawarka maimakon haka.
integrations.noteOura: Daidaita barci, shiryuwa, da bugun zuciya na Oura Ring cikin bayanan lafiyar ranarka. Ana shigo da motsa jiki a sirrance, kamar WHOOP.
integrations.noteSpotify: Zaɓi jerin waƙoƙin motsa jiki daga ɗakin karatunka na Spotify ka haɗa su da shirye-shirye. Suna kunna a Shape Radio da kuma na'urar motsa jiki.
integrations.noteStrava: Haɗa ayyukan Strava da bayanan taswira. Shigo da hanyoyi zai bi tsarin sirri-da-farko iri ɗaya da WHOOP.
integrations.noteWhoop: Daidaita farfaɗowa, barci, ma'aunin jiki, sake zagayowa, da motsa jiki. Motsa jikin da aka shigo na sirri ne har sai ka raba su.
integrations.reconcileMeta: Idan na'urori biyu suka saɓa — zaɓi wacce za a amince da ita
aboutPage.letter.p1: Shape yana nufin daidai abin da sunansa ke nunawa — tsara rayuwarka ta zama yadda kake so. Al’adunka, barcinka, abin da kake dafawa, waƙar da take motsa ka, yadda kake magana da kanka a ranakun wahala, mutanen da kake ciyar da Asabar tare da su. Mun gina Shape ya zama wurin da za ka iya aiki a kan duk waɗannan, bisa sharuɗɗanka.
aboutPage.heroLead: Malamin motsa jikinka ya riga ya tsara makonni masu zuwa. Shirin masanin abincinka ya riga ya zama jerin siyayya kafin ka yi tunanin tambaya. Idan ka buɗe katin motsa jiki, waƙa ta fara — kocinka ne ya zaɓe ta don wannan zaman. Shape Score na kallon duka. Ka rasa rana, ya sani. Ka gina jerin kwanaki, ya nuna. Al’ummar nan ba wani farin ciki da aka tace ba ce — mutane ne da su ma suna tsakiyar hanya, suna neman mafita a lokaci guda. Babu wanda ya gama a nan. Wannan ne ma abin.
aboutPage.idea.h2Post: ta koyarwa, motsa jiki da abinci mai gina jiki.
aboutPage.idea.coachHead: Sana’arka da masu sauraronka — gida ɗaya.
aboutPage.idea.coachBody: Gudanar da dukkan aikinka — abokan ciniki, shirye-shirye, biyan kuɗi — kuma ka gina mabiyanka a dandalin zamantakewa da aka yi don koyarwa, motsa jiki da abinci mai gina jiki. Abubuwanka, abokan cinikinka da kuɗin shigarka a wuri ɗaya: ba manhajoji biyar da masu sauraro marasa dacewa ba. A nan kowa yana motsa jiki tuni — don haka masu sauraronka su ne waɗanda ya kamata. A nan ake gina sana’ar koyarwa, kuma a nan ake ganin ta.
aboutPage.idea.memberHead: Rayuwar motsa jiki da gaske take da zamantakewa.
aboutPage.idea.memberBody: Kociyoyi na gaske, shirye-shiryen da suke naka, da mutanen da suke motsa jiki tare da kai waɗanda su ma suna tsakiyar hanya. Ba tarin kyawawan lokuta ba — rayuwar yau da kullum ta samun ci gaba, aka raba ta da waɗanda suke tare da kai. Kocin ne yake fara maka; al’umma ce take riƙe ka.
aboutPage.idea.closerPre: Kociyoyi suna kawo mutane. Mutane kuma suna gina wurin.
aboutPage.letter.p2: Yana farawa da koci. Samun ƙwararre bai kamata ya zama abin alfarma ba. Yawancin manhajoji suna maye gurbinsu da na’urar hira; yawancin gidajen motsa jiki suna ɓoye masu kyau a bayan kunshin kuɗi. Mun ga akwai hanya mafi kyau: buɗe ƙofa ga malaman motsa jiki, masana abinci mai gina jiki da likitocin abinci masu rijista waɗanda da gaske suke kula, sannan a sa wannan matakin jagora ya zama mai sauƙi ga sauranmu.
aboutPage.letter.p3: Shape yana gina zagayen a kusa da duka. Malamin motsa jikinka yana tsara makonka kafin ka iso — kowane sa’i, kowane sauri, kowane shawara an ɗora tun daren jiya, don kada ka taɓa tsayawa gaban ƙarfe kana tunanin me ke gaba. Masanin abincinka yana gina shirin abinci bisa takamaiman burinka — ko ka cimma adadin macro, ko ka sarrafa haramtacciyar abinci, ko ka gina bisa yanayin lafiya, ko kuma kawai ka ci abinci mafi kyau — sannan wannan shirin ya juya zuwa jerin siyayya da gaske za ka iya siyayya da shi.
aboutPage.letter.p4: Yayin da kake bayyana — rana bayan rana, motsa jiki bayan motsa jiki, ɗabi’a bayan ɗabi’a — Shape Score ɗinka na hawa tare da kai. Yana bin ɗorewarka, yana ba da lada ga ƙoƙarinka, kuma yana nuna matsayin da da gaske ka samu.
aboutPage.letter.p5: Akwai kuma wurin da za ka rubuta abin da kake nufi — ƙarfi, barci, natsuwa, ƙwarin gwiwa, gudun marathon, takamaiman burin gina jiki, ko kawai jin kamar kai kanka kuma. Tsari lokacin da kake buƙata. Ladabtarwar da kai kake ginawa, ba wadda aka miƙa maka ba.
aboutPage.letter.p6Pre: Sannan akwai ɓangaren da babu manhajar da ta yi daidai:
aboutPage.letter.p6Post: . Za ka iya riƙe tafiyarka a ɓoye — ko ka raba ta. Abin da ka dafa, abin da masanin abincinka ya ba da shawara wannan makon, nauyin da ka ɗaga, abin da kocinka ya faɗa. Shawarwari, girke-girke, shawarar abinci mai gina jiki, kociyoyi da likitocin abinci da suka cancanci gwadawa. Cikakken jerin mutane da suke neman mafita a kan abu ɗaya da kai.
aboutPage.letter.pull2: Al’umma ba dandalin tattaunawa ba ce. Mutanen zagayenka ne.
aboutPage.letter.p7: Shape shi ne wurin da kake samun koci, ka gina ɗabi’u, ka samu ƙididdigarka, ka ji waƙa, kuma ka haɗu da mutane. Sauran kawai bayyanawa ne.
aboutPage.founderAlt: Chris Perry, wanda ya kafa Shape
aboutPage.founderBio: Chris ya ɗauki shekaru goma a fannin kuɗi — yana gina alaƙa, yana taimakawa kasuwanci su girma, kuma koyaushe yana sane cewa wata rana zai gina nasa ya kuma gudanar da shi. Ɗan wasa ne tun yarinta, da gudun marathon da kuma Ironman a bayansa, sai ya juyar da wannan himmar zuwa ainihin abin da yake so: lafiya da motsa jiki. An gina Shape a kan imani mai sauƙi — koyarwa mai kyau bai kamata ya zama abin alfarma ko mai tsada ba, kuma bai kamata ya nufi yin sa kai kaɗai ba. Shi ne dandali mafi kyau da zai iya yi don koyarwa ta kai tsaye da raba tafiyar: al’umma ta gaske, da aka gina don taimaka maka ka tsara rayuwarka yadda kake so.
